body: Credibility-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.33 (naive sector base rate 0.47) that: Endurance's new Chennai disc-brake plant starts SOP by 31-Mar-2027. Probability set only by the pre-stated rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AUTO_COMPONENTS_peer_comparison.md section 5): p0 = 0.47 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=13); SAC -43.0 pts x weight 0.31 (N=9) -> p = 0.33. Evidence: Q2FY27 call (04-Nov-2026): 'At our new Chennai plant for disc brake assembly systems, the SOP will start in March 2027.' First promised for Q2FY27 (Nov-25), then July-2026 (May-26) and Sep-2026 (Aug-26). Resolution: YES if the Q4 FY27 call/presentation (or an NSE filing) states SOP at the new Chennai disc-brake plant started on or before 31-Mar-2027. Source: Endurance Q4 FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-15; score with Brier vs the base rate, to test whether the credibility adjustment adds skill.

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.47 (leave-one-out peer strict delivery rate, category 'capacity', n=13); SAC -43.0 pts x weight 0.31 (N=9) -> p = 0.33
data.adjustment_rule: p0 = leave-one-out pooled STRICT delivery rate (specificity-weighted share 'delivered'; partly=0) of the other 4 peers in the promise's category (all-category peer rate if <8 peer promises in that category). p = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC/100, 0.05, 0.95), N = company's scored promises, SAC in points (credit basis: delivered 1, partly 0.5; categories with n<5, or with <2 peers having data, pooled). P(base) = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = sector delivery rate for 'capacity' promises among the other auto-component peers (strict: delivered only, specificity-weighted; n=13). No company-specific information.
data.resolution_rule: YES if the Q4 FY27 call/presentation (or an NSE filing) states SOP at the new Chennai disc-brake plant started on or before 31-Mar-2027.
data.resolution_source: Endurance Q4 FY27 earnings call transcript (NSE)

title: Paper call: Endurance's new Chennai disc-brake plant starts SOP by 31-Mar-2027
